title: aruncus vulgaris var. tomentosus
intro: Aruncus vulgaris var. tomentosus, commonly known as Woolly Goat's Beard, is a plant species in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can be used to relieve coughs and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Aruncus vulgaris var. tomentosus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
